$comment: R3 (RESTRUCTURE.md §2.1, §8 R3): the COO's daily operations report on the Station itself (src/engine/execs.mjs). The engine writes the day's metrics (reports/metrics-<day>.json), then one COO run writes reports/<day>.md, checked on write: the sections, and every USD figure taken from the metrics. The COO may pause a line with line_pause, only for a breach the metrics list (locked rule coo-pause-only). Started by the owner on the page (spend confirmation) or by the routine rt_seed_coo-daily-report once the owner arms it.
